messages:
ashley: Opening a PR to add TritonLite-2B model card + explicit embed sharding migration note. Need bench links + snippet.

ravi: uploaded quick bench: https://internal-bench/reports/tritonlite-2b-2026-03-21. p50/p95 (seq512): GPU p50 40ms p95 118ms; CPU fallback p50 220ms.

samir: snippet draft 12 show client.model('tritonlite-2b').embed(..., shard_count=1) + fallback retry without shard.

kevin: FYI use new SDK pattern, also watch trailing whitespace on MD. I'll run markdownlint.

toni: Found broken anchor on catalog -> compatibility_notes. I'll match heading to anchor and propose CI anchor-check later.

ashley: Put regression test note for long unicode tokens and quantized tokenization drift. Also link raw bench artifact in card.

docs-bot: PR created by ashley: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4589 12 reviewers: @toni @kevin @ravi.

kevin: lint failed (trailing whitespace). Pushing fix. :hammer_and_wrench:

toni: anchor fix pushed; smoke build queued.

ravi: approve benches. Recommend adding sample bench script link and clarifying recommended shard_count: 1 by default, 2 for heavy fanout.

ashley: added migration blurb: SDK v2 requires explicit shard_count; show upgrade snippet. Also included fallback pattern.

kevin: smoke passed. editorial nits addressed. merging after one more quick pass.

ashley: merged. Notifying support about customer migration path. Thanks! :tada:
